gloss: drawing a figure; geometric construction; drafting

definitions.gloss: drawing a figure; geometric construction; drafting (a diagram or plan)
definitions.explanation: The act of producing a geometric figure, diagram, technical drawing, or plan — typically following a set of rules or requirements. Most often encountered in (a) school mathematics, where it refers to classical ruler-and-compass constructions, and (b) engineering/architecture, where it refers to producing technical drawings. Used as a verbal noun with する: {作図|さくず}する ('to draw a figure; to draft').

examples.japanese: {作図|さくず}の{問題|もんだい}。
コンパスと{定規|じょうぎ}だけで{正三角形|せいさんかっけい}を{作図|さくず}する。
examples.english: To construct an equilateral triangle with only a compass and straightedge.

examples.japanese: {設計|せっけい}{図|ず}の{作図|さくず}にはCADソフトが{使用|しよう}される。
examples.english: CAD software is used to draft design drawings.

examples.japanese: {中学校|ちゅうがっこう}の{数学|すうがく}では、{垂直|すいちょく}{二等分線|にとうぶんせん}や{角|かく}の{二等分線|にとうぶんせん}の{作図|さくず}{方法|ほうほう}を{学|まな}ぶ。
examples.english: In junior high school mathematics, students learn how to construct perpendicular bisectors and angle bisectors.

notes:
Compound of {作|さく} ('make; create') and {図|ず} ('figure; diagram'). Literally 'making a figure'. Used both as a noun ({作図|さくず}{問題|もんだい} 'construction problem') and as a verbal noun with する.

USAGE:
- School math sense: classical geometric constructions using only a straightedge and compass ({定規|じょうぎ}とコンパス). Typical Japanese middle-school curriculum topics.
- Engineering / drafting sense: producing technical drawings, often now on a computer with CAD. {作図|さくず}ソフト ('drafting software') is a common phrase.
- Does not refer to drawing pictures or art; for that use {絵|え}を{描|か}く or {描画|びょうが}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {作図|さくず}する: to draw a figure; to draft
- {作図|さくず}{問題|もんだい}: construction problem (in math)
- {作図|さくず}{方法|ほうほう}: method of construction
- {作図|さくず}ツール: drawing/drafting tool
- {作図|さくず}ソフト: drafting/CAD software
- {設計|せっけい}{図|ず}の{作図|さくず}: drafting of design drawings
- コンパスと{定規|じょうぎ}で{作図|さくず}する: to construct with compass and straightedge

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {製図|せいず}: drafting; technical drawing — near-synonym emphasizing professional/engineering drawings. {作図|さくず} is broader and more common in math contexts.
- {描画|びょうが}: drawing (a picture) — artistic/graphical rendering.
- {設計|せっけい}: design — the full process of design, of which drafting is one part.
- {作成|さくせい}: creation; preparation — generic 'making' of documents; less specific than {作図|さくず}.

RELATED WORDS:
- {図形|ずけい}: geometric figure
- {定規|じょうぎ}: straightedge; ruler
- コンパス: (geometric) compass
- {垂直|すいちょく}{二等分線|にとうぶんせん}: perpendicular bisector
- CAD: computer-aided design
